title: Add stampede protection to a hot-key cache path
intent: Checks the answer coalesces concurrent recompute, uses a safe token lock, and adds TTL jitter for a hot read path on AMR.
prompt: Review this cache-aside read path for a few extremely hot SKUs and make it safe under load.

input_artifacts.name: cache-aside.txt
input_artifacts.content: on miss: every pod reads SQL and repopulates; key=product:{sku}; ttl=900s fixed for all keys; lock: SETNX lock:{sku} then DEL later without a token; on redis timeout every pod falls back to SQL simultaneously

embedded_defects.defect: No coalescing: all pods recompute the same expired hot key at once.
Lock has no token and is deleted unconditionally, allowing release of another holder's lock.
Fixed uniform TTL causes synchronized expiry.
